sprint_goal: Harden the v6.2 production system by closing P1 correctness and security gaps and establishing CI test coverage for nightly computation services (Sprint 1), then deliver the Strategy Benchmark page enabling live-to-backtest comparison alongside morning briefing progressive disclosure (Sprint 2).

ST-01.title: Fix AI journal summary on Trade History tab
ST-01.notes: Root causes: (1) frontend dropped data.message from API response — user saw generic 'unavailable' text instead of specific reason; (2) backend exception handler swallowed errors without logging. Fix: store+display data.message in TradeHistory.js; add logger.error() in ai_service.py. No spec deviation — fix aligns with ai_endpoints.md intent.

ST-02.title: Fix R-multiple not displaying on Reflection page
ST-02.notes: Root cause confirmed: base44Client.js read t.r_multiple but backend returns t.net_r_multiple. Fix: one-line field name correction in base44Client.js + 'N/A' display with neutral colour in TradeReflection.js. Playwright SC-RM-01 through SC-RM-03c (5 tests) all pass locally.

ST-03.title: AI endpoint per-endpoint rate limiting hardening
ST-03.notes: In-memory sliding-window RateLimiter (no new deps). daily-briefing: 10 req/min/IP; chat: 30 req/min/IP. 429+Retry-After on breach. Rate limit scenarios test added to test.py (AC-05); fallback count updated 77→78. ai_endpoints.md v1.4→v1.5; openapi.yaml v3.4.0→v3.5.0.

ST-04.title: AI response injection risk assessment
ST-04.notes: 5 inputs assessed. 3 accepted, 2 open. Open: BLG-SEC-01 (context_opts.ticker, P2, v6.4), BLG-SEC-02 (signal ticker validation, P3, v6.4). Filed in backlog. Cybersecurity & Trust Lead + AI Compliance Officer sign-off via agent-mediated protocol.

ST-05.title: AI feature advisory disclaimer visibility assessment
ST-05.notes: Partially compliant. Amber badge PASS on both surfaces (§13 met). Disclaimer text contrast fails WCAG AA: briefing text-slate-500 ~2.7:1; chat footer text-slate-600 ~1.9:1. Remediation: BLG-UX-01 (P3, v6.4), BLG-UX-02 (P2, v6.4). v6.3 delivery not blocked.

ST-06.title: API contract review checklist for AI advisory endpoints
ST-06.notes: 11-item checklist (5 §13, 6 contract completeness) authored and applied retroactively to both AI advisory endpoints. Both ALL PASS at ai_endpoints.md v1.5. BLG-SEC-01 cross-referenced for future ticker validation. API Contracts Owner + Head of Specs Team sign-off.

ST-07.title: Nightly stop computation CI simulation tests
ST-07.notes: 21 tests all passing (0.50s). 7 trailing stop + 5 rebalance exit + 9 inv-vol scenarios. Trailing stop and inv-vol are pure function tests; rebalance exit uses database_stub + monkeypatch.

ST-08.title: Strategy signal regression test specification
ST-08.notes: Spec covers TS (7), RX (5), IV (7) scenarios. Output formats, float tolerance (rel=1e-6), mock requirements, fixture maintenance procedure defined. Director of Quality + QA Lead sign-off. Updated post-ST-07 to clarify IV-03/04/05 cap/floor behavior.

ST-09.title: AI chat response schema validation tests
ST-09.notes: 8 tests, all passing. AC-01: schema validation (required fields, types, error-path conformance). AC-02: advisory-only constraints (advisory=True invariant, system prompt advisory language, directive pattern detector). AC-03: tests in tests/test_ai_chat_schema.py (equivalent CI entry point per sprint_backlog.md).

ST-10.title: §13 boundary test suite for AI advisory endpoints
ST-10.notes: 11 scenarios across D1-D4 dimensions for POST /ai/daily-briefing (5 scenarios) and POST /ai/chat (6 scenarios). Compliance matrix, template for future AI endpoints, and reuse cross-references to tests/test_ai_chat_schema.py. AI Compliance Officer + QA & Testing Owner sign-off.

EPIC-03.test_scenarios: pending — QA & Testing Owner to author Playwright test scenarios before next sprint on this domain

ST-11.title: Strategy Benchmark page: compare live trades against backtest
ST-11.notes: Full implementation: DB schema (backtest_trades, backtest_yearly_performance), 3 backend endpoints (POST /strategy/benchmark/import, GET /strategy/benchmark/summary, GET /strategy/benchmark/trades), import_backtest.py companion script, StrategyBenchmark.js page (3 panels, sticky filters, toggle modes, exit reason badges), Layout.js nav entry, pages.config.js registration, base44Client.js API calls. test.py 78→81, SystemStatus.js fallback 78→81, SC-SS-01b updated. openapi.yaml v3.6.0→v3.7.0. conftest.py _DB_STUB_FUNCTIONS updated. services/__init__.py missing exports (record_nightly_job, get_scheduler_health) fixed. Build clean.

ST-12.title: Morning briefing progressive disclosure
ST-12.notes: Three collapsible sections: Market Context (summary), Signals (actions), Ask the AI (inline chat). localStorage key ai-briefing-collapsed-sections-v1. Default expanded. Playwright SC-PD-05 covers AC-05 (expand all → collapse market context → reload → verify still collapsed). Playwright CI-verifiable only (browsers not available on Ubuntu 26.04 host). Build clean.

ST-13.title: Background scheduler health monitoring endpoint
ST-13.notes: Architecture review (AC-01): scheduler is GitHub Actions external cron, not in-process. Three jobs tracked in-memory: trailing_stop, rebalance_exit, inv_vol_sizing. GET /health/scheduler added to main.py, health_service.py, test.py (78 entries), SystemStatus.js fallback 77→78, SC-SS-01b e2e updated. openapi.yaml v3.4.0→v3.6.0, health_endpoints.md v1.2→v1.3.

ST-14.title: Measure live latency for POST /ai/daily-briefing and POST /ai/chat
ST-14.notes: 7 warm production samples each. daily-briefing: p50=10,296ms p95=11,152ms (⚠ p50 slightly above 10s AC target — model inference latency). chat: p50=6,258ms p95=7,035ms (within 15s AC target). Regression thresholds: daily-briefing p95 > 22,304ms; chat p95 > 14,070ms. §22.3 populated. BLG-OPS-78 closed.

ST-15.title: Render deployment rollback procedure documentation
ST-15.notes: Runbook at docs/operations/render_rollback_runbook.md. Covers: rollback vs fix-forward decision matrix (AC-02), step-by-step Render dashboard procedure (AC-02), verification steps (AC-02), DB migration considerations. Infrastructure & Operations Owner sign-off (AC-03).
